title: Holographic quantum simulation of entanglement renormalization circuits
abstract: Demonstrates D-dimensional system simulation with D-1 dimensional qubit subset using holographic quantum simulation. Prepares ground states of critical systems and measures long-range correlations using fewer qubits. Uses generalized MERA (gMERA) networks on Quantinuum trapped-ion quantum computer with 10 qubits to simulate L=32 critical perturbed Ising model.
key_claims: D-dimensional system simulated with D-1 dimensional qubits
gMERA captures longer correlations than standard MERA with same qubit count
10 qubits simulate L=32 critical Ising model on Quantinuum hardware
Optimal network choice depends on noise level, qubit count, and target state
